newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Scott Corp sees lower first half.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Scott Corp sees lower first half.

text.p: Transport group Scott Corp Ltd said on Tuesday it expected profit for the first half of 1996/97 to June 30 to be below budget and below the 1995/96 half year result due to higher costs and difficult trading conditions.
"It is anticipated that the profit for the December half year will be lower than our budget and the corresponding 1995 half year," chairman Alan Scott told the annual meeting.
"It is expected that the profit for the second half will exceed that of 1995/96," he said.
"However it is too early to predict the full year's result as the state of the economy entering 1997 will influence the scope of the improvement that can be achieved," Scott said.
Scott Corp's managing director Ivan Backman told Reuters in October he expected the company to have an improved net profit in 1996/97 on the previous year's A$5.2 million.
Scott told shareholders trading in the current year had been difficult with revenue five percent below budget as at the end of October 1996.
"The housing industry which provides a significant portion of the group's revenue, is in recession and is affecting the grou's ability to obtain budget," Scott said.
"Trading has been particularly affected in the warehousing, distribution and rail operations because of a sluggish economy," he said.
